ai_summary: Tata Steel Limited has acquired a significant 9.99% stake in APL Apollo Tubes Limited through an on-market block deal for INR 2,100 per share, amounting to approximately INR 58.25 billion. This transaction occurs during an ongoing offer period under SEBI SAST Regulations, signaling a potential open offer or larger strategic move by Tata Steel. A key condition is that the acquired shares are currently held in an escrow account, delaying Tata Steel's ability to exercise voting rights until specific open offer requirements are fulfilled.
